source.title: Fate Weaver, The War Within Season 1

quote: Creates one of: Fateweaved Needle, Fateweaved Mallet
notes: Season 1 Fate Weaver off-hand has a single on-use charge. Weaving ritual at Blood Tower in Azj-Kahet creates one of two associated main-hand weapons without consuming the off-hand. Recipient class/spec-to-weapon outcome is not exhaustively verified; 'classes' remains null. Distinct from season 2/3 Fate Weaver item IDs; never model as disenchanting and do not assign drop probabilities.

source.title: Fate Weaver, The War Within Season 2

notes: Season 2 input item identity distinct from 219381. The Wowhead item comment reports its one-charge weaving ritual creates either named weapon; linked live item pages give 219382 (Needle) and 219941 (Mallet). No numerical outcome probabilities or fully enumerated class/spec gates. Do not confuse item level or season with distinct reward item ID.

source.title: Fate Weaver, The War Within Season 3

notes: Season 3 off-hand tooltip independently confirms one-charge use; generic Fate Weaver reward pages identify the two usual weapon names and item IDs, but this input version lacks a directly verified current in-client output mapping.
